package_policy.private_provenance_policy: Private paths, hostnames, job IDs, usernames, and W&B links are acceptable only if credential-clean; this package minimizes them.
package_policy.checkpoint_identity_policy: Binary model weights remain excluded from Git. Public-safe checkpoint identity metadata, including model ids, revisions, local filenames, file sizes, and SHA256 hashes when available, is included under provenance/.
package_policy.external_payload_policy: Selected large datasets and checkpoints stay outside Git in the Google Drive payload folder. Small result tables and source/config files stay in Git. The evaluation_inputs archive is a convenience mirror of committed exact-input configs/manifests/assets for Drive-based downloads, and checkpoint archives include basic metadata next to selected weights.

external_payload_folder.notes: The folder allows anyone with the link to view and download its contents. Small result tables and source/config files stay in Git; evaluation_inputs mirrors committed exact-input assets for convenience.

runnable_scope.cpu_claim_recompute: scripts/recompute_claims.py recomputes the public numeric claims from committed lightweight artifacts. analysis/README.md gives the full paper-input, release-current, and paper/current comparison commands with required output directories.
runnable_scope.own_policy_training: data_source_dependency/README.md and shortcut_solvability/README.md document first-party trainer/evaluator setup after installing diagnostic dependencies and obtaining named data/checkpoints. Current smoke coverage is recorded in validation_status.
runnable_scope.third_party_policy_evaluation: Committed configs, public-safe adapters/patches, exact small custom assets, reset/init-state artifacts, and external payload references identify the evaluated setup; full third-party checkpoints and datasets are not stored in Git.

This is not a full 96-episode replay/eval reproduction.

Original-vs-release _encode and full forward are exactly equal for one actual LIBERO and one actual CALVIN checkpoint, and seeded augmentation outputs are exactly equal.

validation_status.analysis: analysis/run_analysis.py current --expected-dir passes. paper-inputs regeneration uses committed inputs. compare-paper intentionally exits 1 for 92 labeled frozen-paper/current significance classification differences.
